commits.subject: fix: align cppgc Member and WeakMember storage to their C++ representation
refactor: simplify opaque cppgc member storage and layout regression

comparison.completeness_note: Upstream tag commit equals the merge base, so this is a direct ancestor-to-head comparison rather than a divergent merge-base diff. The response lists one changed file, below GitHub comparison file limits.

verified_delta: Only src/cppgc.rs changes. The old transparent MemberInner/WeakMemberInner wrapper used a byte array sized by generated cppgc__Member_SIZE/cppgc__WeakMember_SIZE constants.

The fork selects opaque aligned storage by that same generated size: 4 bytes uses MaybeUninit<u32>, 8 bytes uses MaybeUninit<u64>. It preserves the selected storage size while correcting its alignment from a byte array to the native word alignment.
A new layout test checks size and alignment for the inner wrappers and public Member<Node>/WeakMember<Node> against the generated native size constants. This test was read, not run.

The comparison shows no change to src/binding.cc, src/binding.hpp, BUILD.gn, build.rs, Cargo.toml, .gitmodules, or the V8 submodule gitlink. No native function signature/symbol or native V8 revision change is present in this two-commit delta.

qualified_inference.assessment: The source delta is consistent with using the upstream native C++ representation and correcting the Rust wrapper to match it. It exposes no native-side divergence that by itself requires a fork-specific native archive for the plain probe.
qualified_inference.not_an_abi_identity_claim: Rust object alignment intentionally differs from upstream Rust code; this is an ABI/layout correctness fix, not proof that all artifacts bearing version 152.2.0 are interchangeable.
qualified_inference.plain_probe_conditions: Use matching aarch64-apple-ios plain archive and generated binding, matching target/profile/features and relevant C++ build options. The generated size constants must correspond to that native archive.
qualified_inference.remaining_uncertainty: Release metadata and a clean native-source delta do not verify how published binary bytes were built, symbol availability, all build flags/ICU/libc++ interactions, iOS initialization, or actual execution. Main's real link/execute probe supplies that empirical evidence.

small_abi_review.unchanged_boundary: This review supports only the planned independent plain-V8 probe. It does not resolve the missing sandbox+pointer-compression iOS artifact for unchanged codex-code-mode-runtime, and does not authorize disabling the ALMA production memory boundary.
